name: Antigravity Remote Control
description: Installs the Antigravity CLI and configures the headless Remote Control daemon.

registrationName.description: Custom registration/session name for this Antigravity Remote daemon (e.g., 'my-box'). Will be prefixed with 'devcontainer-'. If omitted or empty, a persistent unique GUID is automatically generated with 'devcontainer-' prefix.
